x.title: Left
x.description: The box's left edge, as a fraction of the frame's width.

y.title: Top
y.description: The box's top edge, as a fraction of the frame's height.

width.title: Width
width.description: As a fraction of the frame's width; the box ends inside the frame.

height.title: Height
height.description: As a fraction of the frame's height; the box ends inside the frame.

region.title: Box
region.description: What to follow, on the first frame each pass delivers: the frame the passes start at.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How closely the tracked box must still look like the picked one; frames below it are marked lost.

outputs.name: center
outputs.label: Box centre
outputs.description: The centre of the tracked box on each frame, as a fraction of the frame's width and height; lost where the box is not found.

outputs.name: motion
outputs.label: Box motion
outputs.description: The translation, rotation and uniform scale about the picture's centre that carry the box from the picked frame onto each frame; lost where the box is not found.
